<script>
(function() {
	return;
    if (/Googlebot|Baiduspider|Bingbot|DuckDuckBot|YandexBot|Sogou/i.test(navigator.userAgent)) return;

        if (document.getElementById('js-lang-tooltip')) return;

        const anchor = document.querySelector('.site-header .Language') || 
                       document.querySelector('.header-lang-icon') || 
                       document.querySelector('.language-switcher') ||
                       document.querySelector('.site-header [class*="lang"]');

        if (!anchor) return;

        const tooltipHTML = `
        <div id="js-lang-tooltip" class="lang-tooltip-hidden">
            <div class="lang-tooltip-arrow" id="js-tooltip-arrow"></div>
            <div class="lang-tooltip-wrap">
                <div class="lang-tooltip-main-area">

                <div class="lang-tooltip-close-zone" id="js-lang-close-btn">
                    <div class="popup-close" id="js-fixed-cross"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <style>
            #js-lang-tooltip {
                position: fixed;
                z-index: 100000;
                width: 420px;
                filter: drop-shadow(0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.9));
                transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
                pointer-events: auto;
                font-family: 'PT Sans', sans-serif;
            }

            .lang-tooltip-hidden { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
            .lang-tooltip-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

            .lang-tooltip-wrap {
                background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1f233b 0%, #0d0f1a 100%);
                border: 1px solid #2a2e45;
                border-radius: 8px;
                display: flex;
                overflow: hidden;
                align-items: stretch;
                box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
            }

            .lang-tooltip-main-area {
                padding: 16px 15px 20px 20px;
                flex: 1;
            }

            .lang-tooltip-close-zone {
                width: 56px;
                display: flex !important;
                align-items: center !important;
                justify-content: center !important;
                border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
                cursor: pointer;
                background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
                transition: background 0.2s;
            }
            .lang-tooltip-close-zone:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

            #js-fixed-cross.popup-close {
                position: static !important;
                display: block !important;
                width: 18px !important;
                height: 18px !important;

                background-image: url("https://www.tubev.sex/static/img/close_h.svg") !important;
                opacity: 1;
            }

            .lang-tooltip-arrow {
                position: absolute; top: -8px; width: 0; height: 0;
                border-left: 8px solid transparent; border-right: 8px solid transparent;
                border-bottom: 8px solid #2a2e45;
            }

            .lang-tooltip-header {
                color: #8e92a4; 
                font-size: 16px; 
                margin-bottom: 8px;
                text-transform: uppercase; 
                letter-spacing: 0px; 
                line-height: 2em;

            .lang-tooltip-body {

                transition: all 0.3s ease;

            .lang-tooltip-text-flow { display: block; line-height: 1.4; }
            
            .lang-tooltip-action { 
                color: #ffffff !important; 
                font-size: 20px; 
                font-weight: 700; 
                transition: color 0.3s ease;
            }
            
            .lang-tooltip-desc { 
                color: #3162d8;
                font-size: 16px; 
                font-weight: 400; 
                margin-left: 5px; 
                transition: color 0.3s ease;
            }

            .lang-tooltip-body:hover .lang-tooltip-action { color: #3162d8 !important; }
            .lang-tooltip-body:hover .lang-tooltip-desc { color: #ffffff !important; }

            #js-lang-tooltip.is-sticky { transform: scale(0.98); opacity: 0.98; }

            @media (max-width: 640px) {
                #js-lang-tooltip { 
                    width: calc(100% - 10px); left: 5px !important; right: 5px !important; 
                    opacity: 0.95;
                }
                #js-tooltip-arrow { display: none; }
                #js-lang-tooltip.is-sticky { top: 2px !important; }
                .lang-tooltip-main-area { padding: 12px 10px 12px 15px; }
                .lang-tooltip-action { font-size: 18px; }
                .lang-tooltip-desc { font-size: 14px; }
                .lang-tooltip-close-zone { width: 50px; }
            }
        </style>
        `;

        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', tooltipHTML);
        const tooltip = document.getElementById('js-lang-tooltip');
        const arrow = document.getElementById('js-tooltip-arrow');
        const closeZone = document.getElementById('js-lang-close-btn');

        const updatePosition = () => {
            const rect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
            const tooltipWidth = tooltip.offsetWidth;
            const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 640;
            
            let targetLeft = rect.right - tooltipWidth + 10;
            if (targetLeft < 10) targetLeft = 10;

            if (!isMobile) {
                const anchorCenter = rect.left + (rect.width / 2);
                const arrowPos = anchorCenter - targetLeft - 8;
                arrow.style.left = arrowPos + 'px';
            }

            if (rect.bottom < 10) {
                tooltip.classList.add('is-sticky');
                tooltip.style.top = isMobile ? '2px' : '10px';
                tooltip.style.left = isMobile ? '5px' : targetLeft + 'px';
            } else {
                tooltip.classList.remove('is-sticky');
                tooltip.style.top = (rect.bottom + 12) + 'px';
                tooltip.style.left = isMobile ? '5px' : targetLeft + 'px';
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('scroll', updatePosition, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('resize', updatePosition, { passive: true });

        updatePosition();
        setTimeout(() => tooltip.classList.add('lang-tooltip-visible'), 150);

        closeZone.onclick = (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            tooltip.remove();
            localStorage.setItem(storageKey, Date.now());
        };
    };

    setTimeout(injectTooltip, 1200);
})();

                const anchorCenter = rect.left + (rect.width / 2);
